recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片而非顯微鏡圖：前胸、腹部、背部與上肢廣泛分布的暗紅棕色、邊界清楚的斑塊，部分融合並伴脫屑，其間夾雜未受侵犯的正常皮膚區塊，符合進展期蕈狀肉芽腫（mycosis fungoides）的皮膚表現。
features: Four clinical photographs (A-D) of the anterior trunk, back and upper limbs of an adult man
Widespread well-demarcated violaceous to red-brown patches and plaques, many confluent
Scaling and desquamation over plaques, with some darker crusted or eroded areas
Islands of uninvolved (spared) skin between lesions
Involvement extends to arms and scalp/neck; no discrete tumor nodules are clearly visible
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic clinical photograph series of the trunk, back and upper limbs. There are extensive, sharply demarcated, violaceous to red-brown patches and plaques with scaling and desquamation, forming large confluent areas with intervening islands of spared skin, involving well over half of the body surface. Distinct exophytic tumor nodules are not clearly identified in these views. The appearance is consistent with extensive patch/plaque-stage cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (mycosis fungoides) progressing despite therapy, and a biopsy is required to exclude large-cell transformation or a drug reaction.

ddx.vs: Psoriatic plaques have silvery micaceous scale on extensor surfaces, and biopsy shows regular acanthosis with neutrophilic microabscesses rather than epidermotropic atypical CD4+ T cells.
Drug rash can mimic MF clinically, but biopsy shows interface or granulomatous dermatitis without clonal atypical T cells, and TCR gene rearrangement is polyclonal.
Sezary syndrome presents with diffuse erythroderma, lymphadenopathy and a circulating clonal CD4+ CD26- or CD7- population on flow cytometry.
Eczema shows spongiosis without Pautrier microabscesses or atypical cerebriform lymphocytes, and responds to topical steroids.
